text: Hi doctor, my name is Priya Raman. I am a 34 year old pediatric neurosurgeon and I live in Coonoor, a small town in the hills. For the last three weeks I have had episodes of vertigo with a ringing in my left ear, usually in the early morning before surgery. My sister has the same problem. You can reach me on +91 98450 12345 if you need more details. Thank you.
